name: Groe's Stall
source:
You need to buy something from a weird plant spirit who has beef with the powerful entity that protects your city. 

[From [url=https://nerves-nebula.itch.io/groes-stall]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你得从一个古怪的植物精怪手里买点东西——偏偏这家伙正与守护你所在城市的强大存在结下了梁子。

[摘自[url=https://nerves-nebula.itch.io/groes-stall]itch.io[/url]]
